---
page-layout: full
toc: false
format:
  html:
    css: quarto-slide-themer/themer.css
    include-after-body:
      - text: |
          <script src="quarto-slide-themer/theme-core.js"></script>
          <script src="quarto-slide-themer/fonts.js"></script>
          <script src="quarto-slide-themer/themer.js"></script>
---

```{=html}
<style id="themer-preview-css"></style>

<div class="themer-tool">
<div class="themer">

  <div class="themer-controls">

    <!-- The preset swatches are built and wired as usual; drop the `hidden`
         attribute to show them again. -->
    <div id="presets" class="preset-grid" hidden></div>

    <details class="themer-panel pane" id="pane-slide">
      <summary>Slide</summary>
      <div id="slide-colour-fields"></div>
      <div id="slide-size-fields"></div>
    </details>

    <details class="themer-panel pane" id="pane-text">
      <summary>Text</summary>
      <div id="text-font-field"></div>
      <div id="text-body-field"></div>
      <div class="check">
        <input type="checkbox" id="link-text-colors">
        <label for="link-text-colors">Apply to all plain text</label>
      </div>
      <div id="text-colour-fields"></div>
      <div id="text-link-field"></div>
    </details>

    <details class="themer-panel pane" id="pane-code">
      <summary>Code</summary>
      <div id="code-font-field"></div>
      <div id="code-text-field"></div>
      <div class="check">
        <input type="checkbox" id="flat-code">
        <label for="flat-code">Overrule syntax highlighting</label>
        <span class="info" tabindex="0" role="note" aria-label="This forces all code to a single colour, overruling the colour scheme that applies colour to certain syntactic elements (e.g. numbers, operators)"><i class="bi bi-info-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="info-tip">This forces all code to a single colour, overruling the colour scheme that applies colour to certain syntactic elements (e.g. numbers, operators)</span></span>
      </div>

      <div id="code-block-bg-field"></div>
      <div class="check">
        <input type="checkbox" id="link-code-bg">
        <label for="link-code-bg">Apply to all backgrounds</label>
      </div>
      <div id="code-bg-fields"></div>
    </details>

    <section class="themer-panel">
      <h2>Contrast <span id="contrast-summary" class="cx-summary"></span></h2>
      <div id="contrast"></div>
      <p class="note">WCAG 2.1. Which thresholds apply follows the rendered size: from 24px
      (18.66px bold) text counts as large and needs 3:1 for AA and 4.5:1 for AAA, below that
      4.5:1 and 7:1. Hover a row for the size it was measured at.</p>
    </section>

  </div>

  <div class="themer-output">

    <div class="deck-frame">
      <iframe id="deck" src="quarto-slide-themer/slides.html" title="Example RevealJS slides" allowfullscreen></iframe>
    </div>

    <div class="deck-bar">
      <label class="deck-aspect" for="sel-aspect">
        <span>Aspect</span>
        <select id="sel-aspect" class="select" title="Preview only — for a real deck set width and height under format: revealjs"></select>
      </label>
      <button type="button" class="btn-ui" id="btn-random">Randomise</button>
      <button type="button" class="btn-ui" id="btn-reset">Reset</button>
      <a class="btn-ui" id="open-deck" href="quarto-slide-themer/slides.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open in new tab</a>
      <button type="button" class="btn-ui" id="btn-reload">Reload deck</button>
    </div>

    <section class="themer-panel export-panel">
      <button type="button" class="btn-ui export-copy" id="btn-copy" title="Copy" aria-label="Copy the SCSS"><i class="bi bi-clipboard" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
      <pre id="out-scss" class="export" aria-label="Generated custom.scss"></pre>
    </section>

  </div>

</div>
</div>
```
